newsitem.title: USA: Tellabs gets $2.5 mln China contract.
newsitem.headline: Tellabs gets $2.5 mln China contract.

text.p: Tellabs Inc said Tuesday it will supply advanced digital-signal processing equipment to China's Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications and China Telecom, the largest public service providers in China.
The $2.5 million contract was secured by Tellab's Hong Kong-based distribution partner, Genfield Technology Ltd.

Tellabs said its 258 Digital Echo Cancellers and 452 ADPCM Transcoders will be deployed in the ministry's backbone satellite network and installed in more than 30 earth stations serving all the provincial capital and other central cities across China.
Tellabs said the equipment will be shipped to the ministry before year-end. Installation and acceptance of the equipment is expected by the end of 1997.
